question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic cosecant function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcsch}⁡x)=-\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}\,[3\,\operatorname{arcsch}⁡(x-1)] \\  & =3\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}\,[\operatorname{arcsch}⁡(x-1)] \\  & =3\cdot [-\frac{1}{|x-1|\sqrt{1+(x-1)^{2}}}]\cdot (x-1)^{′} \\  & =-\frac{3}{|x-1|\sqrt{1+({x}^{2}-2x+1)}}\cdot 1 \\  & =-\frac{1}{|x-1|}\,\frac{3}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}-2x+2}}.\end{aligned}
$$
